maria: T-minus 45 to deploy-orchestra. Quick checklist: smoke owners? rollback owner? DB migration done? canary plan 1% -> 10% -> full. cc @sam @cheng :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: I'm on rollback. rollback tag ready: release-2026-03-11-rc1
cheng: I'll own smoke. will run smoke suite at 1% canary and post results.
deploybot: Deploy window scheduled at 2026-03-11T20:00Z. CI passed (master -> release branch). Token reserves ok.
maria: @ana you good for metrics watch? Need 5m baseline for p50/p95.
ana: (typo) sorry meant @ana: yes, I'll watch dashboards, alert if error rate >0.5% or p95 increases >200ms. I'll post quick readouts.
jason: DB migration finished on staging. Prod dry-run on replica looks clean. migration script: `ALTER TABLE inference_configs ADD COLUMN ttl_seconds int DEFAULT 3600;`
cheng: q: will router fallback to v2-small if pool saturates?
maria: yes—fallback enabled for this lane to v2-small (compatible model profile), 95% match.
sam: ready to execute rollback if needed. Rollback command: `./deployctl rollback --tag release-2026-03-11-rc1`
maria: OK green from me. Approvals needed: @sam (rollback), @cheng (smoke), @ana (metrics). react with :thumbsup: to approve.
sam: :thumbsup:
cheng: :thumbsup:
ana: (typo) meant @ana: :thumbsup:
deploybot: Canary schedule: 1% -> 10% -> 100% every 5m if no alerts. Auto-fallback thresholds applied. Logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/orchestra/1712345678
maria: Rolling at T-minus 30. I'll post final go/no-go in 5.
